text.tspan: Recorded runs, one per kernel (vecadd, softmax, layernorm, matmul), 40 planted bugs, Triton CPU interpreter in a Nebius sandbox.
Of the 2 new verified tests, one targets an fp16-accumulator mutant that does not compile on Triton 3.6.0 (T4) but does on 3.8.0.
Not a proof that the remaining survivors are harmless.
